test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which option figure would come next in the following figure series? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8f5c1494c846b68c5bdf0f4a29676dcfecbc248a75e33c1b718b7fb7660d75f.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40151f7ef04020709c8928771fdecc06d24d1a5000c3e315524c8141b25c5e46.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85518622ba03dccafbefe24bb689fa108b418873e03de1d01ab7d1c3e7be7339.png] is rotating anticlockwise along the sides of the hexagon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d289c417ce2810962cf65fb5cbf666ea36768ec2b314ad0b800e393eab87ff17.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f9bfd392e5b583c9f5b17ebbbee9d051b0c149c3963694042139bf815195861.png] is perpendicular to one of the sides of the hexagon in figures 2, and 4. It is parallel to one of the sides in figures 1, 3, and 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1cc4d72769437bc17e2f672e41d5d1df2de4cf57ce98ba5c061c3571a4c7373.png] ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76000913ba3bd7212b2912bbe6623e908eac7aa98ea55cb7a60ee9ee553c9242.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f9bfd392e5b583c9f5b17ebbbee9d051b0c149c3963694042139bf815195861.png] is rotating anticlockwise along the sides of the hexagon. 

 
 
• It skips 0 sides from figure 1 to figure 2.
 
• It skips 1 side from figure 2 to figure 3.
 
• It skips 2 sides from figure 3 to figure 4.
 
• It skips 3 sides from figure 4 to figure 5.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd08c5f95e81644803813cc9e39d8202ae70caaaab42a2453ff1f29ebc14fbe8.png] ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95f8ad584a2f2eb7714d2767b96c203479e0bcd1b55152c3d081ee6820fb4988.png] 

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.
